audio.text: Did you manage to get a ticket for Saturday's concert?

options: The concert hall is right next to the gym.
I managed the ticket office at the theater last summer.
Only one in the back row, but I'm not complaining.
My brother plays the drums in a band.

why.en: Indirect "yes": she got a ticket, even if the seat is not great. A gives a place; B repeats "managed" and "ticket" with another meaning; D changes the subject.
why.tr: Dolaylı "evet": koltuk iyi olmasa da bilet almış. A bir yer söylüyor; B "managed" ve "ticket" kelimelerini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; D konuyu değiştiriyor.
why.es: Un "sí" indirecto: consiguió entrada, aunque el asiento no sea bueno. A da un lugar; B repite "managed" y "ticket" con otro sentido; D cambia de tema.
